def sync_apple_caldav_connection(
    connection_id: str, *, full_sync: bool = False
) -> dict[str, int]:
    from calendars.models import CalendarConnection

    connection = CalendarConnection.objects.select_related("user").get(
        id=connection_id,
        provider="APPLE_ICLOUD",
    )
    session = _authenticated_session(connection)
    totals = {"events_added": 0, "events_updated": 0, "events_deleted": 0}

    for connected_calendar in connection.calendars.filter(is_selected=True):
        calendar_result = _sync_apple_calendar(
            session,
            connected_calendar,
            full_sync=full_sync,
        )
        for key, value in calendar_result.items():
            totals[key] += value

    connection.status = "ACTIVE"
    connection.last_success_at = timezone.now()
    connection.last_error_code = ""
    connection.last_error_message = ""
    connection.save(
        update_fields=[
            "status",
            "last_success_at",
            "last_error_code",
            "last_error_message",
            "updated_at",
        ]
    )
    return totals


def export_event_to_apple_caldav(event, connected_calendar) -> dict[str, str]:
    from calendars.models import ExternalEventMirror

    if not connected_calendar.supports_write:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Selected Apple calendar is read-only.")
    if connected_calendar.connection.provider != "APPLE_ICLOUD":
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Calendar is not an Apple iCloud calendar.")

    session = _authenticated_session(connected_calendar.connection)
    mirror = ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
        connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
        local_event=event,
    ).first()
    href = (
        mirror.provider_event_id
        if mirror is not None
        else urljoin(connected_calendar.provider_calendar_id, f"{event.id}.ics")
    )
    ical_body = _event_to_ical(event)
    response = session.request(
        "PUT",
        href,
        data=ical_body,
        headers={"Content-Type": "text/calendar; charset=utf-8"},
        timeout=20,
    )
    if response.status_code not in {200, 201, 204}:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar rejected the event export.")

    ExternalEventMirror.objects.update_or_create(
        connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
        local_event=event,
        defaults={
            "provider_event_id": href,
            "i_cal_uid": str(event.id),
            "provider_etag": response.headers.get("ETag", ""),
            "status": "ACTIVE",
            "presentation_mode": "FULL_DETAILS",
            "share_policy_locked": False,
            "starts_at": event.start_time,
            "ends_at": event.end_time,
            "raw_payload": {"direction": "export"},
            "last_seen_at": timezone.now(),
        },
    )
    return {"href": href, "etag": response.headers.get("ETag", "")}


def _authenticated_session(connection) -> requests.Session:
    session = requests.Session()
    session.auth = (connection.account_email, connection.app_specific_password)
    return session


def _sync_apple_calendar(
    session, connected_calendar, *, full_sync: bool
) -> dict[str, int]:
    if connected_calendar.sync_token and not full_sync:
        response = _sync_collection(session, connected_calendar)
        if response.status_code == 409:
            connected_calendar.sync_token = ""
            connected_calendar.save(update_fields=["sync_token", "updated_at"])
            response = _calendar_query(session, connected_calendar)
    else:
        response = _calendar_query(session, connected_calendar)

    if response.status_code in {401, 403}:
        connection = connected_calendar.connection
        connection.status = "REAUTH_REQUIRED"
        connection.last_error_code = "APPLE_REAUTH_REQUIRED"
        connection.last_error_message = "Apple Calendar credentials were rejected."
        connection.save(
            update_fields=[
                "status",
                "last_error_code",
                "last_error_message",
                "updated_at",
            ]
        )
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar credentials were rejected.")
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar sync failed.")

    return _apply_multistatus(connected_calendar, response.text)

    expansion_start, expansion_end = _recurrence_expansion_window()
    return session.request(
        "REPORT",
        connected_calendar.provider_calendar_id,
        headers={"Depth": "1"},
        data=f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>

  <d:sync-token>{connected_calendar.sync_token}</d:sync-token>
  <d:sync-level>1</d:sync-level>
  <d:prop>
    <d:getetag />
    <cal:calendar-data xmlns:cal="{CALDAV_NS}">
      <cal:expand start="{_caldav_timestamp(expansion_start)}" end="{_caldav_timestamp(expansion_end)}" />
    </cal:calendar-data>

        timeout=30,

        "REPORT",
        connected_calendar.provider_calendar_id,
        headers={"Depth": "1"},
        data=f"""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<cal:calendar-query xmlns:d="{DAV_NS}" xmlns:cal="{CALDAV_NS}">
  <d:prop>
    <d:getetag />

    </cal:calendar-data>
  </d:prop>
  <cal:filter>
    <cal:comp-filter name="VCALENDAR">
      <cal:comp-filter name="VEVENT" />
    </cal:comp-filter>
  </cal:filter>
</cal:calendar-query>""",
        timeout=30,
    )


def _apply_multistatus(connected_calendar, document: str) -> dict[str, int]:
    from calendars.models import IMPORTED_EXTERNAL_EVENT_VISIBILITY, ExternalEventMirror
    from events.models import Event

    result = {"events_added": 0, "events_updated": 0, "events_deleted": 0}
    root = fromstring(document)
    sync_token = _xml_child_text(root, ".//{DAV:}sync-token")

    for dav_response in root.findall(".//{DAV:}response"):
        href = _absolute_icloud_url(_xml_child_text(dav_response, "{DAV:}href"))
        status_text = " ".join(
            node.text or "" for node in dav_response.findall(".//{DAV:}status")
        )
        if "404" in status_text or "410" in status_text:
            result["events_deleted"] += _tombstone_mirrors(
                ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
                    connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
                ).filter(
                    models.Q(provider_event_id=href)
                    | models.Q(provider_event_id__startswith=f"{href}#")
                )
            )
            continue

        calendar_data = _xml_child_text(
            dav_response, ".//{urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-data"
        )
        if not calendar_data:
            continue
        event_payloads = _parse_event_instances(calendar_data)
        if not event_payloads:
            continue

        mode = connected_calendar.import_mode
        if mode == "HIDDEN":
            continue

        seen_provider_ids = set()
        for event_payload in event_payloads:
            provider_event_id = f"{href}{event_payload['provider_occurrence_suffix']}"
            seen_provider_ids.add(provider_event_id)
            title = event_payload["title"] if mode == "FULL_DETAILS" else "Busy"
            location = event_payload["location"] if mode == "FULL_DETAILS" else ""
            description = event_payload["description"] if mode == "FULL_DETAILS" else ""
            visibility = (
                "PRIVATE"
                if mode == "FULL_DETAILS"
                else IMPORTED_EXTERNAL_EVENT_VISIBILITY
            )

            with transaction.atomic():
                event, created = Event.objects.update_or_create(
                    is_external=True,
                    external_source="APPLE_ICLOUD",
                    external_id=provider_event_id,
                    calendar_id=str(connected_calendar.id),
                    defaults={
                        "title": title,
                        "description": description,
                        "location": location,
                        "start_time": event_payload["start_time"],
                        "end_time": event_payload["end_time"],
                        "creator": connected_calendar.connection.user,
                        "family_group": _primary_family_for_user(
                            connected_calendar.connection.user
                        ),
                        "visibility": visibility,
                        "event_status": event_payload["event_status"],
                    },
                )
                ExternalEventMirror.objects.update_or_create(
                    connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
                    provider_event_id=provider_event_id,
                    defaults={
                        "local_event": event,
                        "i_cal_uid": event_payload["uid"],
                        "provider_etag": _xml_child_text(
                            dav_response, ".//{DAV:}getetag"
                        ),
                        "status": "ACTIVE",
                        "source_visibility_raw": event_payload["classification"],
                        "source_class_raw": event_payload["classification"],
                        "presentation_mode": mode,
                        "share_policy_locked": mode != "FULL_DETAILS",
                        "starts_at": event.start_time,
                        "ends_at": event.end_time,
                        "raw_payload": event_payload["raw_payload"],
                        "last_seen_at": timezone.now(),
                    },
                )
            result["events_added" if created else "events_updated"] += 1
        result["events_deleted"] += _tombstone_stale_occurrences(
            connected_calendar,
            href,
            seen_provider_ids,
        )

    if sync_token:
        connected_calendar.sync_token = sync_token
        connected_calendar.last_incremental_sync_at = timezone.now()
        connected_calendar.save(
            update_fields=[
                "sync_token",
                "last_incremental_sync_at",
                "updated_at",
            ]
        )
    return result


def _parse_event_instances(calendar_data: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    calendar = ICalendar.from_ical(calendar_data)
    components = list(calendar.walk("VEVENT"))
    overrides = {
        (
            str(component.get("UID") or ""),
            _occurrence_key(_component_recurrence_id(component)),
        ): component
        for component in components
        if component.get("RECURRENCE-ID")
    }
    master_uids = {
        str(component.get("UID") or "")
        for component in components
        if component.get("RRULE") and not component.get("RECURRENCE-ID")
    }
    payloads: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for component in components:
        recurrence_id = _component_recurrence_id(component)
        if recurrence_id is not None:
            if str(component.get("UID") or "") not in master_uids:
                payloads.append(
                    _event_payload(
                        component,
                        recurrence_key=_occurrence_key(recurrence_id),
                    )
                )
            continue

        if component.get("RRULE"):
            payloads.extend(_expand_recurring_component(component, overrides))
        else:
            payloads.append(_event_payload(component, recurrence_key=""))

    return payloads


def _expand_recurring_component(component, overrides) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    window_start, window_end = _recurrence_expansion_window()
    start_time = _component_start(component)
    end_time = _component_end(component, start_time)
    duration = end_time - start_time
    rule_text = component.get("RRULE").to_ical().decode()
    rule = rrulestr(rule_text, dtstart=start_time)
    excluded_occurrences = _excluded_occurrence_keys(component)
    uid = str(component.get("UID") or "")
    payloads = []

    for occurrence_start in rule.between(window_start, window_end, inc=True):
        recurrence_key = _occurrence_key(occurrence_start)
        if recurrence_key in excluded_occurrences:
            continue
        override = overrides.get((uid, recurrence_key))
        if override is not None:
            payloads.append(_event_payload(override, recurrence_key=recurrence_key))
        else:
            payloads.append(
                _event_payload(
                    component,
                    start_time=occurrence_start,
                    end_time=occurrence_start + duration,
                    recurrence_key=recurrence_key,
                )
            )

    return payloads


def _event_payload(
    component,
    *,
    start_time: datetime | None = None,
    end_time: datetime | None = None,
    recurrence_key: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    start_time = start_time or _component_start(component)
    end_time = end_time or _component_end(component, start_time)
    status = str(component.get("STATUS", "CONFIRMED")).upper()
    return {
        "uid": str(component.get("UID") or uuid4()),
        "title": str(component.get("SUMMARY") or "Busy"),
        "description": str(component.get("DESCRIPTION") or ""),
        "location": str(component.get("LOCATION") or ""),
        "start_time": start_time,
        "end_time": end_time,
        "event_status": "TENTATIVE" if status == "TENTATIVE" else "CONFIRMED",
        "classification": str(component.get("CLASS") or ""),
        "provider_occurrence_suffix": f"#{recurrence_key}" if recurrence_key else "",
        "raw_payload": {
            "summary": str(component.get("SUMMARY") or ""),
            "description": str(component.get("DESCRIPTION") or ""),
            "location": str(component.get("LOCATION") or ""),
            "status": status,
            "recurrence_id": recurrence_key,
        },
    }


def _component_start(component) -> datetime:
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("DTSTART"))


def _component_end(component, start_time: datetime) -> datetime:
    end_raw = component.get("DTEND")
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("DTEND")) if end_raw else start_time


def _component_recurrence_id(component) -> datetime | None:
    if not component.get("RECURRENCE-ID"):
        return None
    return _to_datetime(component.decoded("RECURRENCE-ID"))


def _excluded_occurrence_keys(component) -> set[str]:
    exdate_values = component.get("EXDATE")
    if not exdate_values:
        return set()
    if not isinstance(exdate_values, list):
        exdate_values = [exdate_values]

    excluded = set()
    for exdate_value in exdate_values:
        for item in getattr(exdate_value, "dts", []):
            excluded.add(_occurrence_key(_to_datetime(item.dt)))
    return excluded


def _tombstone_stale_occurrences(
    connected_calendar, href: str, seen_provider_ids: set[str]
) -> int:
    from calendars.models import ExternalEventMirror
    from events.models import Event

    stale_mirrors = ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
        connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
        provider_event_id__startswith=f"{href}#",
        status="ACTIVE",
    ).exclude(provider_event_id__in=seen_provider_ids)
    deleted_count = 0
    for mirror in stale_mirrors:
        local_event_id = mirror.local_event_id
        mirror.status = "TOMBSTONED"
        mirror.tombstoned_at = timezone.now()
        mirror.local_event = None
        mirror.save(
            update_fields=[
                "status",
                "tombstoned_at",
                "local_event",
                "updated_at",
            ]
        )
        if local_event_id:
            Event.objects.filter(pk=local_event_id, is_external=True).delete()
        deleted_count += 1
    return deleted_count


def _to_datetime(value: datetime | date) -> datetime:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        parsed = value
    else:
        parsed = datetime.combine(value, time.min)
    if timezone.is_naive(parsed):
        return timezone.make_aware(parsed, datetime_timezone.utc)
    return parsed


def _recurrence_expansion_window() -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
    now = timezone.now()
    return (
        now - timedelta(days=RECURRENCE_EXPANSION_PAST_DAYS),
        now + timedelta(days=RECURRENCE_EXPANSION_FUTURE_DAYS),
    )


def _caldav_timestamp(value: datetime) -> str:
    return value.astimezone(datetime_timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


def _occurrence_key(value: datetime) -> str:
    return _caldav_timestamp(value)


def _event_to_ical(event) -> str:
    calendar = ICalendar()
    calendar.add("prodid", "-//ClanCal//Calendar Sync//EN")
    calendar.add("version", "2.0")
    item = ICalendarEvent()
    item.add("uid", str(event.id))
    item.add("summary", event.title)
    item.add("description", event.description or "")
    item.add("location", event.location or "")
    item.add("dtstart", event.start_time)
    item.add("dtend", event.end_time)
    item.add(
        "status", "TENTATIVE" if event.event_status == "TENTATIVE" else "CONFIRMED"
    )
    calendar.add_component(item)
    return calendar.to_ical().decode()


def _primary_family_for_user(user):
    profile = getattr(user, "profile", None)
    if profile is not None and profile.primary_family_id:
        return profile.primary_family
    membership = user.family_memberships.first()
    return membership.family if membership is not None else None


def _discover_principal_url(session: requests.Session) -> str:
    response = session.request(
        "PROPFIND",
        "https://caldav.icloud.com/",
        data="""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<propfind xmlns="DAV:">
  <prop><current-user-principal /></prop>
</propfind>""",
        timeout=15,
    )
    if response.status_code in {401, 403}:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Invalid Apple Calendar credentials.")
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Unable to reach Apple Calendar.")

    href = _first_xml_text(response.text, ".//{DAV:}current-user-principal/{DAV:}href")
    if not href:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar principal was not discovered.")
    return _absolute_icloud_url(href)


def _discover_calendar_home_url(session: requests.Session, principal_url: str) -> str:
    response = session.request(
        "PROPFIND",
        principal_url,
        data="""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<propfind xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:cal="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav">
  <prop><cal:calendar-home-set /></prop>
</propfind>""",
        timeout=15,
    )
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar home set was not discovered.")

    href = _first_xml_text(
        response.text,
        ".//{urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-home-set/{DAV:}href",
    )
    if not href:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple Calendar home set was empty.")
    return _absolute_icloud_url(href)


def _discover_calendars(
    session: requests.Session, calendar_home_url: str
) -> list[CalDAVCalendar]:
    response = session.request(
        "PROPFIND",
        calendar_home_url,
        headers={"Depth": "1"},
        data="""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<propfind xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:cal="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav" xmlns:cs="http://calendarserver.org/ns/">
  <prop>
    <displayname />
    <getctag xmlns="http://calendarserver.org/ns/" />
    <sync-token />
    <resourcetype />
    <cal:calendar-color />
    <current-user-privilege-set />
  </prop>
</propfind>""",
        timeout=15,
    )
    if response.status_code >= 400:
        raise AppleCalDAVConnectionError("Apple calendars could not be listed.")

    root = fromstring(response.text)
    calendars: list[CalDAVCalendar] = []
    for dav_response in root.findall(".//{DAV:}response"):
        href = _xml_child_text(dav_response, "{DAV:}href")
        if not href:
            continue
        resource_types = dav_response.findall(".//{DAV:}resourcetype/*")
        is_calendar = any(
            child.tag == "{urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar"
            for child in resource_types
        )
        if not is_calendar:
            continue

        privileges = {node.tag for node in dav_response.findall(".//{DAV:}privilege/*")}
        calendars.append(
            CalDAVCalendar(
                provider_calendar_id=_absolute_icloud_url(href),
                title=_xml_child_text(dav_response, ".//{DAV:}displayname")
                or "Apple Calendar",
                color=_xml_child_text(
                    dav_response,
                    ".//{http://apple.com/ns/ical/}calendar-color",
                )
                or "",
                access_role="owner" if "{DAV:}write" in privileges else "reader",
                supports_write="{DAV:}write" in privileges,
                sync_token=_xml_child_text(dav_response, ".//{DAV:}sync-token") or "",
                etag=_xml_child_text(
                    dav_response, ".//{http://calendarserver.org/ns/}getctag"
                )

def _apply_multistatus(connected_calendar, document: str) -> dict[str, int]:
    from calendars.models import IMPORTED_EXTERNAL_EVENT_VISIBILITY, ExternalEventMirror
    from events.models import Event

    result = {"events_added": 0, "events_updated": 0, "events_deleted": 0}
    root = fromstring(document)
    sync_token = _xml_child_text(root, ".//{DAV:}sync-token")

    for dav_response in root.findall(".//{DAV:}response"):
        href = _absolute_icloud_url(_xml_child_text(dav_response, "{DAV:}href"))
        status_text = " ".join(
            node.text or "" for node in dav_response.findall(".//{DAV:}status")
        )
        if "404" in status_text or "410" in status_text:
            result["events_deleted"] += _tombstone_mirrors(
                ExternalEventMirror.objects.filter(
                    connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
                ).filter(
                    models.Q(provider_event_id=href)
                    | models.Q(provider_event_id__startswith=f"{href}#")
                )
            )
            continue

        calendar_data = _xml_child_text(
            dav_response, ".//{urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-data"
        )
        if not calendar_data:
            continue
        event_payloads = _parse_event_instances(calendar_data)
        if not event_payloads:
            continue

        mode = connected_calendar.import_mode
        if mode == "HIDDEN":
            continue

        seen_provider_ids = set()
        for event_payload in event_payloads:
            provider_event_id = f"{href}{event_payload['provider_occurrence_suffix']}"
            seen_provider_ids.add(provider_event_id)
            title = event_payload["title"] if mode == "FULL_DETAILS" else "Busy"
            location = event_payload["location"] if mode == "FULL_DETAILS" else ""
            description = event_payload["description"] if mode == "FULL_DETAILS" else ""
            visibility = (
                "PRIVATE"
                if mode == "FULL_DETAILS"
                else IMPORTED_EXTERNAL_EVENT_VISIBILITY
            )

            with transaction.atomic():
                event, created = Event.objects.update_or_create(
                    is_external=True,
                    external_source="APPLE_ICLOUD",
                    external_id=provider_event_id,
                    calendar_id=str(connected_calendar.id),
                    defaults={
                        "title": title,
                        "description": description,
                        "location": location,
                        "start_time": event_payload["start_time"],
                        "end_time": event_payload["end_time"],
                        "creator": connected_calendar.connection.user,
                        "family_group": _primary_family_for_user(
                            connected_calendar.connection.user
                        ),
                        "visibility": visibility,
                        "event_status": event_payload["event_status"],
                    },
                )
                ExternalEventMirror.objects.update_or_create(
                    connected_calendar=connected_calendar,
                    provider_event_id=provider_event_id,
                    defaults={
                        "local_event": event,
                        "i_cal_uid": event_payload["uid"],
                        "provider_etag": _xml_child_text(
                            dav_response, ".//{DAV:}getetag"
                        ),
                        "status": "ACTIVE",
                        "source_visibility_raw": event_payload["classification"],
                        "source_class_raw": event_payload["classification"],
                        "presentation_mode": mode,
                        "share_policy_locked": mode != "FULL_DETAILS",
                        "starts_at": event.start_time,
                        "ends_at": event.end_time,
                        "raw_payload": event_payload["raw_payload"],
                        "last_seen_at": timezone.now(),
                    },
                )
            result["events_added" if created else "events_updated"] += 1
        result["events_deleted"] += _tombstone_stale_occurrences(
            connected_calendar,
            href,
            seen_provider_ids,
        )

    if sync_token:
        connected_calendar.sync_token = sync_token
        connected_calendar.last_incremental_sync_at = timezone.now()
        connected_calendar.save(
            update_fields=[
                "sync_token",
                "last_incremental_sync_at",
                "updated_at",
            ]
        )
    return result

def _can_manage_calendar_settings(actor: User, owner: User) -> bool:
    """Allow calendar owners, staff, and admins of the owner's families."""
    if actor == owner or actor.is_staff:
        return True

    owner_family_ids = _get_owner_active_family_ids(owner)
    return FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
        user=actor,
        family_id__in=owner_family_ids,
        is_admin=True,
        is_active=True,
    ).exists()


def _get_owner_active_family_ids(owner: User):
    return owner.family_memberships.filter(is_active=True).values_list(
        "family_id", flat=True
    )


def _default_google_redirect_uri_for_platform(platform: str) -> str:
    if platform == "web":
        return str(getattr(settings, "GOOGLE_CALENDAR_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI_WEB", ""))
    if platform == "mobile":
        return str(getattr(settings, "GOOGLE_CALENDAR_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI_MOBILE", ""))
    return ""


def _infer_platform_from_redirect_uri(redirect_uri: str) -> str:
    return "web" if redirect_uri.startswith(("http://", "https://")) else "mobile"


def _serialize_family_available_members(source_family: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Serialize source-family members/children using prefetched relations when possible."""
    if source_family is None:
        return []

    prefetched_cache = getattr(source_family, "_prefetched_objects_cache", {})
    memberships = prefetched_cache.get("memberships")
    if memberships is None:
        memberships = FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            family=source_family, is_active=True
        ).select_related("user", "user__profile")

    children = prefetched_cache.get("children")
    if children is None:
        children = source_family.children.all()

    members: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for membership in memberships:
        user = membership.user
        members.append(
            {
                "id": str(user.id),
                "type": "user",
                "name": user.get_full_name() or user.username,
            }
        )

    for child in children:
        members.append(
            {
                "id": str(child.id),
                "type": "child",
                "name": f"{child.first_name} {child.last_name}".strip(),
                "color": child.color,
            }
        )

    return members


def _build_available_members_map(
    filters: list[FamilyMemberFilter],
) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    available_members_map: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    for family_filter in filters:
        source_family = family_filter.source_family
        if source_family is None:
            continue

        family_key = str(family_filter.source_family_id)
        if family_key in available_members_map:
            continue

        available_members_map[family_key] = _serialize_family_available_members(
            source_family
        )

    return available_members_map


class ExternalCalendarAccountViewSet(  # type: ignore[misc]
    FamilyAccessMixin, viewsets.ModelViewSet[ExternalCalendarAccount]
):
    """
    API endpoint for external calendar accounts
    """

    queryset = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.all()
    serializer_class = ExternalCalendarAccountSerializer
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get_queryset(self) -> QuerySet[ExternalCalendarAccount]:
        """Filter calendar accounts to only show those owned by the user or family members"""
        base_queryset = self.filter_by_family_access(
            ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.all()
        )
        user_queryset = (
            User.objects.select_related("profile", "profile__primary_family")
            .prefetch_related("socialaccount_set", "child_profile")
            .all()
        )
        child_queryset = (
            Child.objects.select_related(
                "family",
                "family__group_type",
                "added_by",
                "added_by__profile",
                "added_by__profile__primary_family",
                "user_account",
                "user_account__profile",
                "user_account__profile__primary_family",
            )
            .prefetch_related(
                "added_by__socialaccount_set",
                "added_by__child_profile",
                "user_account__socialaccount_set",
                "user_account__child_profile",
            )
            .all()
        )
        return (
            base_queryset.select_related(
                "user",
                "user__profile",
                "user__profile__primary_family",
            )
            .prefetch_related(
                "user__socialaccount_set",
                "user__child_profile",
                "visibility_rules",
                Prefetch("associated_users", queryset=user_queryset),
                Prefetch("associated_children", queryset=child_queryset),
            )
            .order_by("-created_at", "id")
        )

    def get_serializer_class(
        self,
    ) -> type[
        ExternalCalendarAccountSerializer | ExternalCalendarAccountCreateSerializer
    ]:
        if self.action == "create":
            return ExternalCalendarAccountCreateSerializer
        return ExternalCalendarAccountSerializer

    def create(self, request: Request, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Response:
        serializer = cast(
            ExternalCalendarAccountCreateSerializer,
            self.get_serializer(data=request.data),
        )
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        self.perform_create(serializer)
        headers = self.get_success_headers(serializer.data)
        response_serializer = ExternalCalendarAccountSerializer(
            serializer.instance,
            context=self.get_serializer_context(),
        )
        return Response(
            response_serializer.data,
            status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
            headers=headers,
        )

    def perform_create(  # type: ignore[override]
        self, serializer: ExternalCalendarAccountCreateSerializer
    ) -> None:
        """Set the user field to the current user"""
        serializer.save(user=self.request.user)
        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="external_calendar.create",
            outcome="success",
        )

    def perform_destroy(self, instance: ExternalCalendarAccount) -> None:
        """Delete future synced events before removing the account.

        Event.calendar_id is a CharField (not a FK), so CASCADE doesn't apply.
        Only future events are removed; past events are kept as history.
        """
        with transaction.atomic():
            events = Event.secure.for_user(instance.user).filter(
                is_external=True,
                calendar_id=str(instance.id),
                external_source=instance.provider,
                start_time__gte=timezone.now(),
            )
            event_count = events.count()
            events.delete()
            logger.info(
                "ExternalCalendarAccount %s destroyed: deleted %d events",
                instance.id,
                event_count,
            )
            instance.delete()

    def check_object_permissions(
        self, request: Request, obj: ExternalCalendarAccount
    ) -> None:
        """
        Check if user has permission to modify this calendar account
        """
        user = cast("User", request.user)
        if self.action in ["update", "partial_update"]:
            if not _can_manage_calendar_settings(user, obj.user):
                self.permission_denied(
                    request,
                    message="You do not have permission to modify this calendar account.",
                )
        elif self.action == "destroy":
            if obj.user != request.user and not user.is_staff:
                self.permission_denied(
                    request,
                    message="You do not have permission to modify this calendar account.",
                )

        super().check_object_permissions(request, obj)

    def _gather_conflicts(
        self, calendar: ExternalCalendarAccount
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Build a list of unresolved conflicts for a calendar using local tracking models.
        Currently treats modified and deleted external events as conflicts requiring review.
        """
        modified_conflicts = []
        for modified in calendar.modified_events.select_related("event"):
            event = modified.event
            modified_conflicts.append(
                {
                    "id": event.id,
                    "conflict_type": "modified_local",
                    "local_event": {
                        "id": str(event.id),
                        "title": event.title,
                        "start_time": event.start_time,
                        "end_time": event.end_time,
                    },
                    "remote_event": {
                        "external_id": modified.external_id,
                        "calendar_id": calendar.calendar_id,
                    },
                    "created_at": modified.modified_at,
                    "resolved": False,
                }
            )

        deleted_conflicts = [
            {
                "id": uuid.uuid5(
                    uuid.NAMESPACE_URL, f"{calendar.id}:{deleted.external_id}"
                ),
                "conflict_type": "deleted_local",
                "local_event": {
                    "calendar_id": str(calendar.id),
                },
                "remote_event": {"external_id": deleted.external_id},
                "created_at": deleted.deleted_at,
                "resolved": False,
            }
            for deleted in calendar.deleted_events.all()
        ]

        conflicts = modified_conflicts + deleted_conflicts
        conflicts.sort(key=lambda conflict: conflict["created_at"], reverse=True)
        return conflicts

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def associate_users(self, request: Request, pk: str | None = None) -> Response:
        """Associate users and children with this calendar for tagging purposes"""
        from users.models import Child

        calendar = self.get_object()
        user = cast("User", request.user)

        if not _can_manage_calendar_settings(user, calendar.user):
            return Response(
                {"detail": "You do not have permission to modify this calendar."},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        # Get user IDs and child IDs from request data
        user_ids = request.data.get("user_ids", [])
        child_ids = request.data.get("child_ids", [])

        if not isinstance(user_ids, list):
            return Response(
                {"detail": "user_ids must be a list of user IDs."},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        # Clear existing associations and add new ones
        calendar.associated_users.clear()
        calendar.associated_children.clear()

        # Restrict associations to the calendar owner's active families.
        owner_family_ids = _get_owner_active_family_ids(calendar.user)
        family_members = FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            family_id__in=owner_family_ids,
            is_active=True,
        ).values_list("user_id", flat=True)

        # Filter user_ids to only include family members
        valid_user_ids = [uid for uid in user_ids if uid in family_members]

        # Add the associated users
        if valid_user_ids:
            calendar.associated_users.add(*valid_user_ids)

        # Handle child associations
        if child_ids and isinstance(child_ids, list):
            # Get children from the calendar owner's active families.
            family_children = Child.objects.filter(
                family_id__in=owner_family_ids, id__in=child_ids
            )
            calendar.associated_children.add(*family_children)

        # Return the updated calendar
        serializer = self.get_serializer(calendar)
        return Response(serializer.data)

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def sync(self, request: Request, pk: str | None = None) -> Response:
        """Trigger a sync for this calendar account"""
        calendar = self.get_object()
        user = cast("User", request.user)

        # Check if user is the owner
        if calendar.user != request.user and not user.is_staff:
            return Response(
                {"detail": "You do not have permission to sync this calendar."},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        # Check if sync is enabled
        if not calendar.sync_enabled:
            return Response(
                {"detail": "Sync is disabled for this calendar."},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        # Parse sync options
        serializer = CalendarSyncSerializer(data=request.data)
        if not serializer.is_valid():
            return Response(serializer.errors, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        try:
            # Trigger the sync task
            from calendars.tasks import sync_calendar as sync_calendar_task

            sync_calendar_task.delay(calendar.id)
        except Exception as e:
            # Log the error but don't block the API response
            logger.error(
                f"Failed to schedule sync for calendar {calendar.id}: {str(e)}"
            )

        return Response(
            {"detail": f"Sync for calendar {calendar.account_name} has been scheduled."}
        )

            google_calendar_oauth_flags.is_legacy_fallback_enabled(user)
        )

            try:

                    "Google OAuth state validation failed for user %s: %s",
                    user.id,

                    request=request,
                    operation="calendar.google_connect",
                    outcome="error",
                    reason="invalid_state",

                return Response(
                    {"detail": "Invalid OAuth state."},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,

                    request=request,
                    operation="calendar.google_connect",
                    outcome="error",
                    reason="state_user_mismatch",
                )
                return Response(
                    {"detail": "OAuth state does not match the authenticated user."},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                )
            if validated_state["redirect_uri"] != redirect_uri:
                record_wide_event(
                    request=request,
                    operation="calendar.google_connect",
                    outcome="error",
                    reason="state_redirect_mismatch",
                )
                return Response(
                    {"detail": "redirect_uri does not match signed OAuth state."},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                )
        elif legacy_fallback_enabled:
            redirect_uri = (
                redirect_uri
                or _default_google_redirect_uri_for_platform("mobile")
                or _default_google_redirect_uri_for_platform("web")
            )
            if not redirect_uri:
                return Response(
                    {
                        "detail": (
                            "No default Google OAuth redirect URI is configured for "
                            "legacy fallback."
                        )
                    },
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                )
        else:
            errors: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
            if not state:
                errors["state"] = ["This field is required."]
            if not redirect_uri:
                errors["redirect_uri"] = ["This field is required."]
            return Response(errors, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        oauth_client_id = getattr(settings, "GOOGLE_CALENDAR_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID", "")

            settings,

    @action(detail=False, methods=["post"], url_path="connect-apple")
    def connect_apple(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        """
        Connect Apple Calendar from mobile device.
        Creates ExternalCalendarAccount with provider='APPLE' and stores
        the list of device calendars available for syncing.

        NOTE: This endpoint is for native iOS device calendar access via
        react-native-calendar-events. For iCloud public calendar URLs
        (webcal:// or https://...ical), use the ICS connect endpoint instead:
        POST /api/calendar-connections/ics-url/
        """
        serializer = AppleCalendarConnectSerializer(data=request.data)
        if not serializer.is_valid():
            return Response(serializer.errors, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        user = cast("User", request.user)
        calendars_data = serializer.validated_data["calendars"]
        account_name = serializer.validated_data["account_name"]

        try:
            with transaction.atomic():
                # Check if Apple Calendar already connected for this user
                existing = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.filter(
                    user=user, provider="APPLE"
                ).first()

                if existing:
                    # Update existing account with new calendar list
                    calendar = existing
                    calendar.account_name = account_name
                    calendar.save(update_fields=["account_name", "updated_at"])
                    # Clear old selections and recreate
                    calendar.apple_calendar_selections.all().delete()
                else:
                    # Create new Apple Calendar account
                    calendar = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.create(
                        user=user,
                        provider="APPLE",
                        account_name=account_name,
                        provider_uid=f"apple-device-{user.id}",
                        is_active=True,
                        sync_enabled=True,
                    )
                    # Associate user with their calendar
                    calendar.associated_users.add(user)
                    # Create default visibility settings
                    CalendarVisibility.objects.create(calendar=calendar)

                # Create AppleCalendarSelection entries for each device calendar
                for cal_data in calendars_data:
                    AppleCalendarSelection.objects.create(
                        external_account=calendar,
                        device_calendar_id=cal_data["id"],
                        calendar_title=cal_data["title"],
                        calendar_color=cal_data.get("color", ""),
                        calendar_source=cal_data.get("source", ""),
                        calendar_type=cal_data.get("type", ""),
                        is_primary=cal_data.get("isPrimary", False),
                        allows_modifications=cal_data.get("allowsModifications", True),
                        is_enabled=True,
                    )

                logger.info(
                    f"Apple Calendar connected for user {user.id} with "
                    f"{len(calendars_data)} calendars"
                )

                response_serializer = ExternalCalendarAccountSerializer(calendar)
                return Response(
                    response_serializer.data, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED
                )

        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to connect Apple Calendar: {str(e)}")
            return Response(
                {"detail": "Failed to connect Apple Calendar. Please try again."},
                status=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            )

    def _normalize_all_day_event(
        self,
        start_date: datetime.datetime,
        end_date: datetime.datetime,
        is_all_day: bool,
    ) -> tuple[datetime.datetime, datetime.datetime]:
        """
        Normalize all-day events to prevent timezone shift issues.
        All-day events from iOS may arrive with midnight times that shift
        across timezones. This normalizes them to span exactly 24 hours.
        """
        if not is_all_day:
            return start_date, end_date

        # For all-day events, normalize to start of day in UTC
        # and ensure the event spans exactly 24 hours per day
        start_normalized = start_date.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)

        # Calculate number of days
        duration = end_date - start_date
        days = max(1, duration.days)
        if duration.seconds > 0:
            days += 1  # Partial day counts as full day

        end_normalized = start_normalized + datetime.timedelta(days=days)

        return start_normalized, end_normalized

    def _find_duplicate_event(
        self,
        calendar_id: str,
        title: str,
        start_date: datetime.datetime,
        end_date: datetime.datetime,
        exclude_external_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> Event | None:
        """
        Find potential duplicate events from multi-device syncing.
        Matches events with same title and times within 1 minute tolerance.
        """
        # 1 minute tolerance for time matching
        time_tolerance = datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)

        queryset = Event.objects.filter(  # nosemgrep: clancal.security.event-objects-bypass-secure-manager
            is_external=True,
            external_source="APPLE",
            calendar_id=calendar_id,
            title=title,
            start_time__gte=start_date - time_tolerance,
            start_time__lte=start_date + time_tolerance,
            end_time__gte=end_date - time_tolerance,
            end_time__lte=end_date + time_tolerance,
        )

        if exclude_external_id:
            queryset = queryset.exclude(external_id=exclude_external_id)

        return queryset.first()

    @action(detail=False, methods=["post"], url_path="apple/sync")
    def apple_sync(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        """
        Bulk sync events from Apple Calendar.
        Mobile app pushes all events from selected calendars.

        Features:
        - All-day event timezone normalization
        - Multi-device event deduplication
        - Staleness and full sync tracking
        """
        serializer = AppleCalendarBulkSyncSerializer(data=request.data)
        if not serializer.is_valid():
            return Response(serializer.errors, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        user = cast("User", request.user)
        events_data = serializer.validated_data["events"]
        full_sync = serializer.validated_data.get("full_sync", False)

        try:
            calendar = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.get(user=user, provider="APPLE")

            if not calendar.sync_enabled:
                return Response(
                    {"detail": "Sync is disabled for this calendar."},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                )

            # Get enabled calendar IDs
            enabled_calendar_ids = set(
                calendar.apple_calendar_selections.filter(is_enabled=True).values_list(
                    "device_calendar_id", flat=True
                )
            )

            # Create sync log
            sync_log = SyncLog.objects.create(
                calendar=calendar,
                status="SUCCESS",
                events_added=0,
                events_updated=0,
                events_deleted=0,
                events_skipped=0,
            )

            # Get user's primary family
            family_group = None
            if hasattr(user, "profile") and user.profile.primary_family:
                family_group = user.profile.primary_family
            elif user.family_memberships.exists():
                first_membership = user.family_memberships.first()
                if first_membership:
                    family_group = first_membership.family

            # Track processed external IDs for full sync deletion
            processed_external_ids: set[str] = set()

            # Get locally deleted event IDs to skip
            deleted_event_ids = set(
                calendar.deleted_events.values_list("external_id", flat=True)
            )

            # Track duplicate detections for logging
            duplicates_merged = 0

            with transaction.atomic():
                for event_data in events_data:
                    external_id = event_data["external_id"]
                    calendar_id_from_device = event_data.get("calendar_id", "")

                    # Skip if from a disabled calendar
                    if (
                        calendar_id_from_device
                        and calendar_id_from_device not in enabled_calendar_ids
                    ):
                        sync_log.events_skipped += 1
                        continue

                    # Skip if locally deleted
                    if external_id in deleted_event_ids:
                        sync_log.events_skipped += 1
                        continue

                    processed_external_ids.add(external_id)

                    # Normalize all-day events for timezone safety
                    start_date, end_date = self._normalize_all_day_event(
                        event_data["start_date"],
                        event_data["end_date"],
                        event_data.get("all_day", False),
                    )

                    # Check if event exists by external_id
                    existing_event = Event.objects.filter(  # nosemgrep: clancal.security.event-objects-bypass-secure-manager
                        is_external=True,
                        external_id=external_id,
                        external_source="APPLE",
                        calendar_id=str(calendar.id),
                    ).first()

                    if existing_event:
                        # Update existing event
                        existing_event.title = event_data["title"]
                        existing_event.description = event_data.get("description") or ""
                        existing_event.location = event_data.get("location") or ""
                        existing_event.start_time = start_date
                        existing_event.end_time = end_date
                        existing_event.save(
                            update_fields=[
                                "title",
                                "description",
                                "location",
                                "start_time",
                                "end_time",
                                "updated_at",
                            ]
                        )
                        sync_log.events_updated += 1
                    else:
                        # Check for duplicate from different device
                        duplicate = self._find_duplicate_event(
                            calendar_id=str(calendar.id),
                            title=event_data["title"],
                            start_date=start_date,
                            end_date=end_date,
                            exclude_external_id=external_id,
                        )

                        if duplicate:
                            # Merge: update existing event with new external_id
                            # This handles multi-device sync where same calendar
                            # event has different IDs on different devices
                            duplicate.external_id = external_id
                            duplicate.description = event_data.get("description") or ""
                            duplicate.location = event_data.get("location") or ""
                            duplicate.save(
                                update_fields=[
                                    "external_id",
                                    "description",
                                    "location",
                                    "updated_at",
                                ]
                            )
                            sync_log.events_updated += 1
                            duplicates_merged += 1
                        else:
                            # Create new event
                            Event.objects.create(  # nosemgrep: clancal.security.event-objects-bypass-secure-manager
                                title=event_data["title"],
                                description=event_data.get("description") or "",
                                location=event_data.get("location") or "",
                                start_time=start_date,
                                end_time=end_date,
                                creator=user,
                                family_group=family_group,
                                is_external=True,
                                external_source="APPLE",
                                external_id=external_id,
                                calendar_id=str(calendar.id),
                                visibility=IMPORTED_EXTERNAL_EVENT_VISIBILITY,
                            )
                            sync_log.events_added += 1

                # Handle full sync deletion
                if full_sync and processed_external_ids:
                    events_to_delete = Event.objects.filter(  # nosemgrep: clancal.security.event-objects-bypass-secure-manager
                        is_external=True,
                        external_source="APPLE",
                        calendar_id=str(calendar.id),
                    ).exclude(external_id__in=processed_external_ids)

                    sync_log.events_deleted = events_to_delete.count()
                    events_to_delete.delete()

                # Update calendar sync timestamps
                now = timezone.now()
                calendar.last_synced = now
                calendar.last_successful_sync = now
                update_fields = ["last_synced", "last_successful_sync"]

                if full_sync:
                    calendar.last_full_sync = now
                    update_fields.append("last_full_sync")

                calendar.save(update_fields=update_fields)

                # Complete sync log
                sync_log.completed_at = now
                sync_log.save()

            logger.info(
                f"Apple Calendar sync completed for user {user.id}: "
                f"added={sync_log.events_added}, updated={sync_log.events_updated}, "
                f"deleted={sync_log.events_deleted}, skipped={sync_log.events_skipped}, "
                f"duplicates_merged={duplicates_merged}"
            )

            return Response(
                {
                    "detail": "Sync completed successfully.",
                    "events_added": sync_log.events_added,
                    "events_updated": sync_log.events_updated,
                    "events_deleted": sync_log.events_deleted,
                    "events_skipped": sync_log.events_skipped,
                    "duplicates_merged": duplicates_merged,
                    "last_synced": calendar.last_synced,
                    "is_stale": calendar.is_stale(),
                    "needs_full_sync": calendar.needs_full_sync(),
                }
            )

        except ExternalCalendarAccount.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"detail": "Apple Calendar not connected."},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Apple Calendar sync failed: {str(e)}")
            return Response(
                {"detail": "Sync failed. Please try again."},
                status=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            )

            return Response(
                {"detail": "Apple Calendar not connected."},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to sync Apple Calendar event: {str(e)}")
            return Response(
                {"detail": "Failed to sync event."},
                status=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            )

    @action(
        detail=False,
        methods=["delete"],
        url_path=r"apple/events/(?P<event_external_id>[^/.]+)",
    )
    def apple_delete_event(
        self, request: Request, event_external_id: str | None = None
    ) -> Response:
        """
        Delete a synced Apple Calendar event.
        Called when event is deleted on device.
        """
        if not event_external_id:
            return Response(
                {"detail": "Event ID is required."},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        user = cast("User", request.user)

        try:
            calendar = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.get(user=user, provider="APPLE")

            with transaction.atomic():
                # Find and delete the event
                deleted_count, _ = (
                    Event.objects.filter(  # nosemgrep: clancal.security.event-objects-bypass-secure-manager
                        is_external=True,
                        external_id=event_external_id,
                        external_source="APPLE",
                        calendar_id=str(calendar.id),
                    ).delete()
                )

                if deleted_count > 0:
                    # Track deletion to prevent re-sync
                    DeletedExternalEvent.objects.get_or_create(
                        calendar=calendar,
                        external_id=event_external_id,
                    )
                    logger.info(f"Apple Calendar event deleted: {event_external_id}")
                    return Response({"detail": "Event deleted successfully."})
                else:
                    return Response(
                        {"detail": "Event not found."},
                        status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                    )

        except ExternalCalendarAccount.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"detail": "Apple Calendar not connected."},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to delete Apple Calendar event: {str(e)}")
            return Response(
                {"detail": "Failed to delete event."},
                status=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            )

    @action(detail=False, methods=["delete"], url_path="apple")
    def apple_disconnect(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        """
        Disconnect Apple Calendar.
        Removes the ExternalCalendarAccount and all synced events.
        """
        user = cast("User", request.user)

        try:
            calendar = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.get(user=user, provider="APPLE")

            with transaction.atomic():
                # Delete all synced events from this calendar
                deleted_events_count = Event.objects.filter(  # nosemgrep: clancal.security.event-objects-bypass-secure-manager
                    is_external=True,
                    external_source="APPLE",
                    calendar_id=str(calendar.id),
                ).delete()[0]

                # Delete the calendar account (cascades to related models)
                calendar_id = calendar.id
                calendar.delete()

                logger.info(
                    f"Apple Calendar disconnected for user {user.id}: "
                    f"calendar_id={calendar_id}, events_deleted={deleted_events_count}"
                )

                return Response(
                    {
                        "detail": "Apple Calendar disconnected successfully.",
                        "events_deleted": deleted_events_count,
                    }
                )

        except ExternalCalendarAccount.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"detail": "Apple Calendar not connected."},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to disconnect Apple Calendar: {str(e)}")
            return Response(
                {"detail": "Failed to disconnect Apple Calendar."},
                status=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            )


class ExternalAccountVisibilityViewSet(
    viewsets.ModelViewSet[ExternalAccountVisibility]
):
    """
    API endpoint for managing visibility rules for a specific ExternalCalendarAccount.
    Accessed via nested routes: /api/external-calendars/{account_pk}/visibility/
    """

    serializer_class = ExternalAccountVisibilitySerializer
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get_queryset(self) -> QuerySet[ExternalAccountVisibility]:
        """
        Filter rules based on the parent ExternalCalendarAccount ID from the URL
        and ensure the requesting user owns the parent account.
        """
        account_pk = self.kwargs.get("account_pk")
        if not account_pk:
            # This shouldn't happen with nested routing but handle defensively
            return ExternalAccountVisibility.objects.none()

        # Ensure the user owns the parent account
        user = cast("User", self.request.user)
        try:
            account = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.get(
                pk=account_pk,
                user=user,
            )
        except ExternalCalendarAccount.DoesNotExist:
            # Return empty queryset if user doesn't own the parent account
            return ExternalAccountVisibility.objects.none()

        return ExternalAccountVisibility.objects.filter(external_account=account)

    def perform_create(  # type: ignore[override]
        self, serializer: ExternalAccountVisibilitySerializer
    ) -> None:
        """Associate the rule with the parent ExternalCalendarAccount from the URL."""
        from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied

        account_pk = self.kwargs.get("account_pk")
        if account_pk is None:
            raise PermissionDenied("Account ID is required.") from None

        user = cast("User", self.request.user)
        try:
            account = ExternalCalendarAccount.objects.get(
                pk=account_pk,
                user=user,
            )
            serializer.save(external_account=account)
            record_wide_event(
                request=self.request,
                operation="calendar_visibility.create",
                outcome="success",
            )
        except ExternalCalendarAccount.DoesNotExist:
            # This should ideally be caught by permission checks earlier, but handle here too
            raise PermissionDenied(
                "Cannot create visibility rule for this account."
            ) from None

    def check_object_permissions(
        self, request: Request, obj: ExternalAccountVisibility
    ) -> None:
        """Ensure the user owns the parent ExternalCalendarAccount."""
        user = cast("User", request.user)
        if obj.external_account.user != request.user and not user.is_staff:
            self.permission_denied(
                request,
                message="You do not have permission to manage visibility for this account.",
            )
        # No need to call super() as we are checking based on the parent object owner

                Prefetch("associated_children", queryset=child_queryset),
            )

        )

    def get_serializer_class(
        self,
    ) -> type[InternalCalendarSerializer | InternalCalendarCreateSerializer]:

            return InternalCalendarCreateSerializer
        return InternalCalendarSerializer

    def perform_create(  # type: ignore[override]
        self, serializer: InternalCalendarCreateSerializer
    ) -> None:

        serializer.save(user=self.request.user)

            request=self.request,
            operation="internal_calendar.create",
            outcome="success",
        )

    def check_object_permissions(self, request: Request, obj: InternalCalendar) -> None:
        """
        Check if user has permission to modify this calendar
        """
        user = cast("User", request.user)
        if self.action in ["update", "partial_update"]:
            if not _can_manage_calendar_settings(user, obj.user):
                self.permission_denied(
                    request,
                    message="You do not have permission to modify this calendar.",
                )
        elif self.action == "destroy":
            if obj.user != request.user and not user.is_staff:
                self.permission_denied(
                    request,
                    message="You do not have permission to modify this calendar.",
                )

        super().check_object_permissions(request, obj)

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def associate_users(self, request: Request, pk: str | None = None) -> Response:
        """Associate users and children with this calendar for tagging purposes"""
        from users.models import Child

        calendar = self.get_object()
        user = cast("User", request.user)

        if not _can_manage_calendar_settings(user, calendar.user):
            return Response(
                {"detail": "You do not have permission to modify this calendar."},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        # Get user IDs and child IDs from request data
        user_ids = request.data.get("user_ids", [])
        child_ids = request.data.get("child_ids", [])

        if not isinstance(user_ids, list):
            return Response(
                {"detail": "user_ids must be a list of user IDs."},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        # Clear existing associations and add new ones
        calendar.associated_users.clear()
        calendar.associated_children.clear()

        # Restrict associations to the calendar owner's active families.
        owner_family_ids = _get_owner_active_family_ids(calendar.user)
        family_members = FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            family_id__in=owner_family_ids,
            is_active=True,
        ).values_list("user_id", flat=True)

        # Filter user_ids to only include family members
        valid_user_ids = [uid for uid in user_ids if uid in family_members]

        # Add the associated users
        if valid_user_ids:
            calendar.associated_users.add(*valid_user_ids)

        # Handle child associations
        if child_ids and isinstance(child_ids, list):
            # Get children from the calendar owner's active families.
            family_children = Child.objects.filter(
                family_id__in=owner_family_ids, id__in=child_ids
            )
            calendar.associated_children.add(*family_children)

        # Return the updated calendar
        serializer = self.get_serializer(calendar)
        return Response(serializer.data)

class CalendarConnectionViewSet(viewsets.ViewSet):
    """
    API endpoint for connecting to external calendar services
    """

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    # Add JSONParser to accept JSON requests for actions like ics_url
    parser_classes = [MultiPartParser, FormParser, JSONParser]

    def get_permissions(self):
        if getattr(self, "action", "") == "google_webhook":
            return [permissions.AllowAny()]
        return super().get_permissions()

    def _get_connection(self, pk: str | None) -> CalendarConnection:
        return CalendarConnection.objects.get(pk=pk, user=self.request.user)

    @action(detail=False, methods=["post"], url_path="apple/verify")
    def apple_verify(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        serializer = AppleCalDAVCredentialsSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        try:
            discovery = verify_apple_caldav_account(
                account_email=serializer.validated_data["account_email"],
                app_specific_password=serializer.validated_data[
                    "app_specific_password"
                ],
            )
        except AppleCalDAVConnectionError as exc:
            return Response({"detail": str(exc)}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        calendars = [
            {
                "provider_calendar_id": calendar["provider_calendar_id"],
                "title": calendar["title"],
                "color": calendar.get("color", ""),
                "access_role": calendar.get("access_role", ""),
                "supports_write": calendar.get("supports_write", False),
                "import_mode": "BUSY_ONLY",
            }
            for calendar in discovery.get("calendars", [])
        ]
        return Response(
            {
                "account_label": discovery.get("account_label")
                or serializer.validated_data["account_email"],
                "account_email": serializer.validated_data["account_email"],
                "principal_url": discovery.get("principal_url", ""),
                "calendar_home_url": discovery.get("calendar_home_url", ""),
                "calendars": calendars,
            }
        )

    @action(detail=False, methods=["post"], url_path="apple/connect")
    def apple_connect(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        serializer = AppleCalDAVCredentialsSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        user = cast("User", request.user)
        account_email = serializer.validated_data["account_email"]
        app_specific_password = serializer.validated_data["app_specific_password"]

        try:
            discovery = verify_apple_caldav_account(
                account_email=account_email,
                app_specific_password=app_specific_password,
            )
        except AppleCalDAVConnectionError as exc:
            return Response({"detail": str(exc)}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        with transaction.atomic():
            connection, _ = CalendarConnection.objects.update_or_create(
                user=user,
                provider="APPLE_ICLOUD",
                account_email=account_email,
                defaults={
                    "mode": "IMPORT_EXPORT",
                    "account_label": discovery.get("account_label") or account_email,
                    "auth_type": "APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD",
                    "principal_url": discovery.get("principal_url", ""),
                    "calendar_home_url": discovery.get("calendar_home_url", ""),
                    "status": "ACTIVE",
                    "last_error_code": "",
                    "last_error_message": "",
                },
            )
            connection.app_specific_password = app_specific_password
            connection.save(update_fields=["_app_specific_password", "updated_at"])

            seen_calendar_ids: set[str] = set()
            for calendar_data in discovery.get("calendars", []):
                provider_calendar_id = calendar_data["provider_calendar_id"]
                seen_calendar_ids.add(provider_calendar_id)
                ConnectedCalendar.objects.update_or_create(
                    connection=connection,
                    provider_calendar_id=provider_calendar_id,
                    defaults={
                        "title": calendar_data.get("title") or "Apple Calendar",
                        "color": calendar_data.get("color", ""),
                        "access_role": calendar_data.get("access_role", ""),
                        "supports_write": bool(
                            calendar_data.get("supports_write", False)
                        ),
                        "sync_token": calendar_data.get("sync_token", ""),
                        "collection_etag": calendar_data.get("etag", ""),
                        "is_selected": True,
                        "import_mode": "BUSY_ONLY",
                    },
                )
            if seen_calendar_ids:
                connection.calendars.exclude(
                    provider_calendar_id__in=seen_calendar_ids
                ).update(is_selected=False)

        response_serializer = CalendarConnectionSerializer(connection)
        return Response(response_serializer.data, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

    @action(detail=True, methods=["get"], url_path="calendars")
    def connection_calendars(self, request: Request, pk: str | None = None) -> Response:
        try:
            connection = self._get_connection(pk)
        except CalendarConnection.DoesNotExist:
            return Response({"detail": "Not found."}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)
        serializer = ConnectedCalendarSerializer(connection.calendars.all(), many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)

    @action(
        detail=True,
        methods=["patch"],
        url_path=r"calendars/(?P<calendar_id>[^/.]+)",
    )
    def update_connected_calendar(
        self, request: Request, pk: str | None = None, calendar_id: str | None = None
    ) -> Response:
        user = cast("User", request.user)
        try:
            connection = CalendarConnection.objects.select_related("user").get(pk=pk)
            calendar = connection.calendars.get(pk=calendar_id)
        except (CalendarConnection.DoesNotExist, ConnectedCalendar.DoesNotExist):
            return Response({"detail": "Not found."}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)

        if not _can_manage_calendar_settings(user, connection.user):
            return Response(
                {"detail": "You do not have permission to modify this calendar."},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        requested_mode = request.data.get("import_mode")
        if (
            requested_mode in {"PRIVATE_DETAILS", "FULL_DETAILS"}
            and connection.user != user
        ):
            return Response(
                {"detail": "Only the calendar owner can widen imported details."},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        serializer = ConnectedCalendarPolicySerializer(

        )
